hint.question: One sentence: in which population, what compared with what, affecting what, over how long.

mandate.ask: Start with action draft of science_requirement_brief to structure this into a requirement brief and show me the gaps; I will fill them and then commit to open the project.
mandate.intro: I am opening a new project. Here is the need, stated up front:

wizard.needQuestion: The research question is the one field required to build a mandate.
wizard.openHint: Spend two minutes saying what you want to study, before any work starts

ph.data: Dataset name, source, licence; write "none" if you have none
ph.deadline: e.g. submit by 2027-03, or "within six months"
ph.deliverables: Conference abstract / journal paper / preregistration / internal report
ph.domain: Biomedical / neuroscience / psychology / economics / computer science
ph.equipment: Instruments, compute, software; write "ordinary workstation" if nothing special
ph.ethics: Approval id if you have one; otherwise the committee you plan to use
ph.license: Data use agreement or authorisation; name the licence for public data
ph.people: e.g. just me, with help on statistics
ph.question: e.g. In community adults over 60, tai chi three times weekly versus usual care, on falls over six months
ph.subjects: Population, where from, roughly how many

wizard.title: State the research need
